listed_quote.quote: Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (NYSE: TTP), Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NYSE: NDP),

announcement.quote: the Board of Directors has approved a proposal to merge Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NDP) with and into Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (TTP).

deals.notes: The special meeting set for 2021-04-07 was to be convened and adjourned to 2021-06-04 (DEFA14A 2021-04-06). No excerpt states the vote result, completion or termination. The 2021-05-25 and 2022 DEF 14A annual-meeting proxies still list TTP and NDP as separate companies, but they do not say what happened to the merger, so no outcome is recorded.
